title: Catan
content: Trade wood for sheep, build roads and race to ten points. The game that brought modern European board games to the mainstream.

title: Ticket to Ride
content: Collect coloured train cards and claim railway routes across the map. Won the Spiel des Jahres in 2004 and still the best gateway game going.

title: Carcassonne
content: Draw a tile, place it, drop a meeple. A medieval landscape of cities, roads and monasteries grows on the table every game.

title: Pandemic
content: Four diseases spread across the world and the whole table works together to cure them. The game that made co-operative play mainstream.

title: Codenames
content: Two spymasters give one-word clues to link their team's secret agents. The party game for people who like a puzzle.

title: Azul
content: Draft beautiful Portuguese tiles and lay them on your wall without wasting any. Quick to learn, quietly cut-throat.

title: Wingspan
content: Attract birds to your wildlife reserves with an engine of food, eggs and habitats. Over 170 illustrated birds and a dice-tower birdfeeder.

title: 7 Wonders
content: Draft cards over three ages to build an ancient civilisation. Plays up to seven people in about half an hour.

title: Dominion
content: The game that invented deck-building. Start with copper and estates and buy your way to a kingdom.

title: Terraforming Mars
content: Raise the temperature, oxygen and oceans of Mars as rival corporations. Hundreds of unique project cards.

title: Gloomhaven
content: A huge tactical dungeon campaign in a box that weighs nearly 10 kg. Topped BoardGameGeek's ranking for years.

title: Splendor
content: Collect gem tokens, buy development cards and attract nobles. Twenty minutes of satisfying engine-building.

title: Scythe
content: An alternate-history 1920s Europe of farms and giant mechs. Gorgeous art by Jakub Różalski.

title: Twilight Struggle
content: The entire Cold War in one two-player game. The USA against the USSR, card by card.

title: Agricola
content: Feed your 17th-century farming family through harsh harvests. Worker placement at its most tense.

title: Puerto Rico
content: Choose roles, plant crops and ship goods. The long-time number one on BoardGameGeek.

title: Power Grid
content: Buy power plants, fuel them and connect cities. An economic game where the leader pays more.

title: Dixit
content: Dreamlike picture cards and clues that are neither too obvious nor too obscure. Won the Spiel des Jahres in 2010.

title: Kingdomino
content: Domino-style tiles build a five-by-five kingdom in fifteen minutes. Spiel des Jahres 2017.

title: Root
content: Woodland creatures fight asymmetric wars. Every faction plays a completely different game.

title: Brass: Birmingham
content: Build canals, railways and industries in the Industrial Revolution West Midlands. A heavy economic classic.
hook: #21 · Gavan Brown, Matt Tolman and Martin Wallace, 2018

title: Spirit Island
content: Island spirits drive off colonising invaders together. A co-op with real strategic depth.

title: Everdell
content: Woodland critters build a city under a three-dimensional Ever Tree. Lovely art and tight worker placement.

title: Cascadia
content: Draft habitats and wildlife of the Pacific Northwest. Spiel des Jahres 2022.

title: Patchwork
content: A two-player quilting race with Tetris-shaped patches and buttons for currency.

title: Jaipur
content: Trade spices, cloth and camels to become the Maharaja's merchant. The perfect two-player card game.

title: Love Letter
content: Sixteen cards, one tiny box, endless deduction. Get your letter to the princess.

title: The Resistance: Avalon
content: Loyal knights against hidden servants of Mordred. Social deduction for five to ten players.

title: Secret Hitler
content: Liberals and fascists in 1930s Germany, with one player hiding the worst secret.
hook: #29 · Mike Boxleiter, Tommy Maranges and Max Temkin, 2016

title: Werewolf
content: Villagers by day, wolves by night. The original social deduction game.

title: Chess
content: Sixty-four squares and thirty-two pieces. The strategy game against which every other is measured.

title: Go
content: Black and white stones on a 19x19 grid. Simple rules, near-infinite depth.

title: Backgammon
content: One of the oldest board games known, mixing dice luck with real skill.

title: Scrabble
content: Seven letter tiles and a board of premium squares. The world's best-known word game.

title: Monopoly
content: Buy property, build hotels and bankrupt your family. Based on Lizzie Magie's The Landlord's Game.

title: Cluedo
content: Who did it, where, and with what? Colonel Mustard in the library with the candlestick. Invented in Birmingham.

title: Risk
content: World domination by dice. The conquest game that started countless family arguments.

title: Trivial Pursuit
content: Six categories, six wedges, a lot of general knowledge. The pub quiz in a box.

title: Mastermind
content: Crack the hidden four-peg colour code with logic. A two-player deduction classic.

title: Connect Four
content: Drop discs into a vertical grid to get four in a row.

title: Pictionary
content: Draw it, don't say it. The drawing game for any party.

title: Articulate!
content: Describe as many words as you can in thirty seconds. A British party favourite.

title: Exploding Kittens
content: A kitten-powered version of Russian roulette that broke Kickstarter records.
hook: #43 · Elan Lee, Matthew Inman and Shane Small, 2015

title: Sushi Go!
content: Pass the plates and pick the best sushi combos. A pocket-sized drafting game.

title: Takenoko
content: Grow bamboo, irrigate gardens and keep a hungry panda fed for the Emperor.

title: King of Tokyo
content: Giant monsters roll dice to smash Tokyo. Yahtzee with claws.

title: Small World
content: Fantasy races rise, conquer and decline on a map too small for all of them.

title: Lords of Waterdeep
content: Secret lords recruit adventurers to complete quests in the Dungeons & Dragons city.

title: Concordia
content: Build a trading network across the Roman Empire using a hand of personality cards.

title: Great Western Trail
content: Drive cattle from Texas to Kansas City in a big, satisfying strategy game.

title: Viticulture
content: Inherit a Tuscan vineyard and turn it into a winery. Worker placement through the seasons.

title: Mysterium
content: A ghost sends dream visions to psychics to solve its murder.

title: Sagrada
content: Draft dice to build a stained-glass window that follows strict colour rules.

title: Hanabi
content: Build a fireworks display while holding cards you can't see. Spiel des Jahres 2013.

title: The Crew
content: A co-operative trick-taking card game told across fifty space missions.

content: Investigators face Lovecraftian horrors in a story-driven living card game.

title: Betrayal at House on the Hill
content: Explore a haunted house until one player turns traitor. Fifty possible scenarios.

title: Dead of Winter
content: Survivors hold a colony through a zombie winter, each with a secret objective.

title: Star Wars: Rebellion
content: The whole original trilogy as a two-player hunt for the hidden Rebel base.

title: Twilight Imperium
content: An all-day space opera of diplomacy, trade and war for the galactic throne.

title: War of the Ring
content: The Fellowship sneaks to Mount Doom while the armies of Sauron advance.
hook: #61 · Roberto Di Meglio, Marco Maggi and Francesco Nepitello, 2004

title: Blood Rage
content: Viking clans battle for glory as Ragnarök destroys the world.

title: Inis
content: Celtic clans compete to become king of Ireland through card drafting and diplomacy.

title: Through the Ages
content: Build a civilisation from antiquity to the modern age through cards.

title: Castles of Burgundy
content: Develop an estate in the Loire Valley with dice and hexagonal tiles.

title: Orléans
content: Draw followers from a bag to grow your influence in medieval France.

title: Istanbul
content: Move your merchant and assistants through the bazaar to collect rubies.

title: Tigris & Euphrates
content: Knizia's masterpiece of conflict between ancient Mesopotamian dynasties.

title: Lost Cities
content: Fund expeditions in a two-player card game of risky investment.

title: Modern Art
content: Auction paintings and decide what the market thinks art is worth.

title: El Grande
content: Grandees fight for control of the regions of medieval Spain.

title: Acquire
content: Build hotel chains, buy shares and profit from mergers. An early classic of business games.

title: Diplomacy
content: Pre-First World War Europe with no dice, only negotiation and betrayal.

title: Stratego
content: Hidden ranks and a captured flag. A two-player battle of bluff.

title: Blokus
content: Place polyomino pieces corner to corner and block your rivals.

title: Santorini
content: Build and climb Greek towers. Simple rules with god powers on top.

title: Hive
content: A boardless two-player game of surrounding the opposing queen bee.

title: Quoridor
content: Race to the other side while placing walls to block your opponent.

title: Onitama
content: A five-by-five martial arts chess variant with shifting move cards.

title: Telestrations
content: The telephone game with drawings. Guaranteed laughs.

title: Wavelength
content: Guess where a clue falls on a spectrum between two ideas.
hook: #81 · Wolfgang Warsch, Alex Hague and Justin Vickers, 2019

title: Just One
content: Everyone writes one-word clues, and duplicates cancel out. Spiel des Jahres 2019.

title: Decrypto
content: Pass coded messages to your team without the other team cracking them.

title: Camel Up
content: Bet on a chaotic camel race where camels stack on each other. Spiel des Jahres 2014.

title: Qwirkle
content: Match colours and shapes on wooden tiles. Abstract and family friendly.

title: Ra
content: Auction for ancient Egyptian treasures before the Sun God's era ends.

title: Mansions of Madness
content: App-driven Lovecraftian investigations in creepy mansions.

title: Descent: Journeys in the Dark
content: A dungeon crawl of heroes against an overlord player.

title: HeroQuest
content: The fantasy dungeon game from Milton Bradley and Games Workshop, reissued in 2021.

title: Space Hulk
content: Space Marines and Genestealers in claustrophobic corridors. Tense and deadly.

title: Arkham Horror
content: Investigators close gates before an Ancient One awakens.

title: Eldritch Horror
content: Globe-trotting Lovecraftian mysteries to stop the end of the world.

title: Clank!
content: Deck-building through a dungeon where every noise wakes the dragon.

title: Heat: Pedal to the Metal
content: 1960s motor racing where you manage speed, heat and corners.

content: Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo. Hundreds of animal cards.

title: Dune: Imperium
content: Deck-building and worker placement on Arrakis.

title: The Quacks of Quedlinburg
content: Push your luck brewing potions from a bag of ingredients.

title: Uno
content: Match colour or number, then shout Uno when you have one card left. One of the best-selling card games ever made.

title: Dobble
content: Every pair of cards shares exactly one symbol. Spot it first.

title: Jenga
content: Pull blocks from the tower without letting it fall. Designed by a British games maker.
